verdict.rationale: Docs clearly document a graph-based workflow engine with `.then()`, `.branch()`, `.parallel()`, suspend/resume, and steps that call agents, supporting explicit graph/branching/parallel composition (mastra-gh-3, mastra-docs-21, mastra-docs-36, mastra-docs-53, mastra-docs-38). However, a hands-on user report explicitly describes workflows and branching logic (especially with non-LLM agents) as 'clunky' and that 'the whole thing got messy' after months of use, directly contradicting the ease-of-use claims for this capability (mastra-comm-7); another user cites rigidity/opinionated patterns making complex custom flows hard to maintain (mastra-comm-8). Missing for 10: an explicit documented loop construct (only .then/.branch/.parallel shown), and independent benchmarks confirming smooth branching/loop composition at scale.
